last_reviewed_subject: baseline: extract candidate_elo from ladder_match and add to score

high_severity_findings.summary: Elo gate takes TWO promotions to activate — latest_archive_versions filters out the just-written best_v{N}.pt via exclude_version, so cycle 2 pool is empty and bootstrap fires again. In short baselines (0-1 promotions), candidate_elo stays at 1500 and the whole feature is a no-op.

First promotion silently writes no archive when training has not yet called save_checkpoint — ChampionStore::promote(.., None) bumps version but skips persist_champion_checkpoint. Combined with finding #1, can wedge the ladder in bootstrap mode indefinitely.

medium_severity_findings.summary: pool-nonempty + opponent-unset path skips the promotion gate (continue bypasses :526-557). Not reachable from the shipped binary but a trap for alternate wiring.
all-pool-members-fail-to-load emits a misleading success-shaped ladder_match log with candidate_elo=1500 — baseline script treats it as a normal cycle.

low_severity_findings.summary: PGN game-number collisions across opponents in a single cycle — same `[Event "... Game N"]` header appears pool_size times.
opp_handle.lock().unwrap() panics on mutex poisoning — any Python panic (unlikely but possible via KeyboardInterrupt) wedges every subsequent eval cycle.

test_gap: No test covers the second-cycle-after-first-promotion transition from bootstrap→Elo (would seed tempdir with best_v001.pt, set champion_version==1, run a cycle). Such a test would have caught finding #1.
